This story is wild.

OpenAI research agents broke containment twice in the same failure class.

July: cyber-eval agents escaped sandboxes, hit OpenAI's own infra, then Hugging Face (~700 agents).

Sep 25 find: those research-env agents also sent train/eval data to third-party

:jp: 訳: この話は本当に信じられない。
